name: Kromium
description: The main entry point for the Kromium library. Provides synchronized factory access to create and manage the active singleton KromiumEngine instance using a specified KromiumConfig and KromiumEngineProvider.
whenToUse: Call Kromium.createEngine(config, provider) during application bootstrap to create the shared uninitialized KromiumEngine instance.

methods.name: createEngine
methods.signature: @JvmStatic @Synchronized fun createEngine(config: KromiumConfig, provider: KromiumEngineProvider): KromiumEngine
methods.description: Creates the Kromium engine using the provided configuration and provider. The engine is NOT automatically initialized. You must call engine.initialize() on a background thread so you can observe engine.state from the UI.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.Kromium
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.jcef.JcefProvider

val config = KromiumConfig.builder().build()
val engine = Kromium.createEngine(config, JcefProvider)
engine.initialize()
